question: Simplify: 57 − [82 − (72 ÷ 3 − (17 − 40 ÷ 5) ÷ 9)]
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Solve inner brackets first using BODMAS: (17 − 40 ÷ 5) = 17 − 8 = 9 Next round bracket: (72 ÷ 3 − 9 ÷ 9) = 24 − 1 = 23 Square bracket: [82 − 23] = 59 Final calculation: 57 − 59 = −2 **∴ The correct answer is -2.**
